source_description: The Alliance for Mission & Renewal (AMR) — a left-of-center PCA advocacy group founded around 2024 in the Tim Keller / Redeemer-network mold. AMR pushes a 'unity, faithfulness, and flourishing' frame within the PCA — code for resisting the conservative/confessionalist GRN-aligned wing on women's roles, sexuality (post-Revoice), and Kellerite urban missiology. The group has a substack (a4mr.substack.com), a website (a4mr.org), and an alternate domain (alliance4renewal.com). The 8-member Executive Board is published; broader 'membership' is not public.

notes: Only the 8-person Executive Board + 1 named Advisory member (Keller) are formally listed as 'leadership' by AMR. The other 8 names are content contributors / authors / speakers featured on the AMR site (a4mr.org) — they are functionally aligned with AMR but the site does not call them 'signatories.' Presbytery affiliations are educated guesses based on each person's known church and were NOT scraped from AMR's site (AMR doesn't publish that metadata) — these should be verified against the MOOP directory rather than treated as authoritative. AMR has no public 'signatory list' the way Warhurst's Hall of Infamy does — this is by design; AMR is a 501(c)(3) (EIN 92-4022322, registered Marriottsville MD per Cause IQ) advocacy nonprofit, not an open petition. For directory cross-referencing, the 8 board members + Whitfield are the highest-confidence identifications. There is meaningful overlap with the Letter of Lament list (Russ Whitfield signed both).
